title: Scene 1 — The Ripples on Lake Awing
content:
Dawn broke over the crater hills surrounding Lake Awing. The sacred waters lay still as black glass, reflecting the silhouette of the Fon’s royal council gathered beside the sacrificial altar.

Nkeng, a young environmental scholar born in the kingdom, stood before the king with satellite maps and soil samples clutched in his weathered hands.

"Your Majesty," Nkeng pleaded, his voice breaking through the solemn drone of ceremonial flutes. "The foreign mining consortium has promised gold for your treasury, but their chemical runoffs will poison Lake Awing within three seasons. Once the sacred waters die, the ancestral fish die, and the land will turn to barren clay!"

High Priestess Bih stepped forward, tossing cowrie shells onto the sacred stones. "The spirits do not speak of gold, Nkeng. They speak of drought and sorrow if greed enters our gates."

The Fon shifted in his leopard-skin throne. "Nkeng, you come with papers from the city, but the palace needs schools and hospitals. How can we refuse the wealth of nations?"

"True wealth, my King," Nkeng replied, kneeling to touch the sacred soil, "is leaving our children a kingdom where the water can still be drunk without poison."

title: Scene 2 — Challenging the Elders and the Oath
content:
=== SCENE 2 — CHALLENGING THE ELDERS AND THE OATH ===

Setting: the Misty Shores of Lake Awing. The atmosphere is charged with tension.

Nkeng: "We have walked under this cloud long enough. If we do not speak now, the truth will be buried beneath the soil of our ancestors!"

Fon of Kom & High Priestess Bih: "Do you dare defy the council? Tradition was carved into stone long before your father learned to walk."

Nkeng: "Tradition that suffocates its own children is not wisdom—it is fear wearing a crown. Today, we choose life."

The onlookers murmur. The drumbeats slow, then erupt in a rhythmic cadence that reverberates across the hills.

Fon of Kom & High Priestess Bih: "Then let heaven be the judge between your conviction and our law."

With a decisive movement, Nkeng turns toward the gathered assembly. The stage dims to an amber glow as destiny shifts into motion.
